display_name: John, companion of James the Presbyter

names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 1 Νοεμβρίου, «Άγιοι Ιωάννης ο Επίσκοπος και Ιάκωβος ο Πρεσβύτερος», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the title on his name link behind the line for 1 ноября ст. ст., «Иоанн Бет-Селевкийский (Персидский), сщмч.», with the rank word left off. The day's own line declines the forename and gives no by-name, as «Иоанна епископа».

death.note: Two calendars a dozen years apart on one man, and the interval holds both. saint.gr gave «έζησαν στα χρόνια του βασιλιά των Περσών Σαβωρίου (332 μ.Χ.)», which this folder carried as about 332; days.pravoslavie.ru's line for the same pair on the same day closes «(ок. 345)», about 345. Nothing is chosen. The Russian life that the calendar hangs behind his name closes «(+ 343)», but that is the company of the Greek 20 November, whose identity with this man is refused here, so 343 is recorded and is not a bound.

feast.note: His name page lists one other day, «20 ноября». That is the day the Greek calendar keeps the company of Persian bishops and martyrs on, and this corpus already holds a separate John there, `john-martyr-20-november`, off saint.gr's «Άγιοι Ισάκιος, Ιωάννης, Σαβώριος, Ωνάμ, Παππίας και Ισαάκιος». Deciding that two commemorations are one man is not a reader's, so nothing is folded: the row is written for the day page that listed him, 20 ноября is recorded here and was not read, and he does not render on it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 1 ноября ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Иоанна епископа и Иакова пресвитера, в Персии пострадавших (ок. 345).»

attestations.note: The line's «Сщмч.» is hieromartyr and its «епископа» bishop, both of which this folder already held from saint.gr; the pairing with James the presbyter and the day are the Greek's too. The name link gives him a see the Greek page does not, «Иоанн Бет-Селевкийский (Персидский)», John of Bet-Seleucia. The life the calendar hangs behind his name is the company killed under Shapur II, in which a bishop John is stoned; that company is the Greek 20 November's, and because the fold is refused no narrative is taken from it and no `office` is written from a see that reaches this folder only through the fold.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (1 October 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 1ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιοι Ιωάννης ο Επίσκοπος και Ιάκωβος ο Πρεσβύτερος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 1 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The entry enumerates two men, each with his own heading and his own rank, so it is two folders. No see is recorded, because the page calls him «ο Επίσκοπος» and names no city for him; the only place in the notice is the kingdom of the Persians. The corpus keeps a great many Johns, and this one can only be told apart by his companion, which is why the English form hangs on James. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (1 October 2026).
